assumptions: The CLI step ran in a scratch copy, not the worktree, because the base patch is uncommitted and discarding CLI output with git would have discarded the base too. The result matched the pre-build review: the CLI adds the `cn` package and imports it, so the Manual install fallback was used.

Alert takes a required `tone` prop (danger, rate-limited, info, success, neutral) and renders the tone's icon itself, so callers never pass an icon. The registry's `variant` (default, destructive) is gone. success, info and neutral are tested but have no caller yet: ui-raise-review and ui-detail-start use them.

ErrorSummary's root is `<Alert tone="danger" role="group" ...>`: it reuses the Alert's look and icon and overrides the role (the registry's props spread lets a caller's role win). The old 1.5px destructive border is dropped, since DESIGN says notices have no border.

StateSurface's `icon` is optional on purpose: the detail screen renders every state through one StateSurface so the h1 never remounts, and gives an icon only for not found. Without an icon it draws no tile and no surface classes, and `className` styles the section (failure message and loaded card as before). Failure state is not drawn as a state surface: the spec lists only not found for the detail screen.

The action in a state surface is wrapped by each caller in `<div className="mt-3">` (4 callers) to match the mockup's 12px extra margin (signed out, not found, locked, disputes empty; the detail screen's NotFoundCard does the same). That is plain duplication of one class; a StateSurface `action` slot is the upgrade, not added because the detail screen passes each state's card as children.
The rate-limited Alert shows waitCopy's sentence as AlertTitle (bold), as the old ProblemNotice showed it in <strong>.

The two-commit split in the spec (presentation, then test updates) is for the supervisor: nothing is committed and the unit-test updates are in the same working tree. Test-only files: every *.test.tsx in story_files; the production files are the rest.
The base ui-tokens-icons patch could not be committed locally (guard refuses commits), so diff-hash covers base plus story; see test_results.diff_hash_how.
Mockup drift left as the spec says (16px notice icons, waitCopy single sentence).
Not run: e2e (QA's), the real-API smoke (stack lock held), npm audit (no package change).

The Copy pill uses the Button secondary variant (cobalt outline on the card colour) at size compact. The mockup draws a transparent pill with a currentColor outline, which would need colour overrides on every state; the shared variant keeps the design system's outline and makes the pill a normal action on the notice. If QA wants the currentColor look, it is a className override on this one Button.
The Button's border-[1.5px] is the design system's existing outline; the diff adds no raw px value to a component.
The base ui-tokens-icons change is still uncommitted, so diff-hash covers base plus story plus fix round.
